name: Zithers & Harps of the World
subtitle: Guzheng, Kankles & more
shortDescription: 9 zithers, harps and plucked board instruments to play: Guzheng, Gayageum, Sasando and Kanklės.
longDescription:
Zithers & Harps of the World: 9 zithers, harps and plucked board instruments from 9 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Guzheng, Gayageum, Sasando, Kanklės, Kantele, Adungu, Valiha tube zither, Saung gauk and Mountain Dulcimer.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play zithers, harps and plucked board instruments, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
